title: 毎日王冠の後に・運命、彼方に集いて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she wins the race, the phenomenal running Mejiro Ardan witnesses from Oguri Cap and the other racers leaves a lasting impression on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the racers exchange compliments after the race, Inari One reveals that the Eternal Top Three will all be present at the upcoming autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan is elated to learn that she'll get to meet the Eternal Top Three on the turf. The autumn Tenno Sho—history's turning point—is fast approaching.
